summary: All new features + regressions verified. Backend: 39/39 pytest pass (28 regression + 11 new quest/attributes). QUESTS: GET /api/quests?scope=daily|weekly|monthly|all returns correct shape (objectives{label,current,target}, complete, claimed, reward_label, global_completions, global_percent). scope=all buckets three arrays. Fresh-user Answer-the-Call flow: starts incomplete, claim while incomplete -> 400 'Objectives not met'; after POST /api/workouts/log the quest flips complete=true & objectives current=1/1; POST /api/quests/claim awards +60 XP and marks claimed=true; second claim -> 400 'Already claimed'; unknown quest_id -> 400/404. Global stats verified: independent User B sees global_completions increment by exactly 1 after User A claims, and global_percent stays in [0,100]. Profile attributes: GET /api/profile/attributes returns stats{strength,power,speed,endurance,grit} all clamped 5..100, overall int, class_title str, class_tier in S/A/B/C/D/E, app_percentile 0..100 (Freak got S-CLASS ALL-ROUNDER; Intermediate athlete got A-CLASS). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): QUESTS tab renders with all 4 scope chips (quest-scope-daily/weekly/monthly/all), 3 daily quest cards with progress %, reward, 'N cleared · X%' subtext. Tapping quest-<id> opens QUEST INFO modal with GOAL objectives table [current/target], GLOBAL CLEARANCE (players + %), REWARD, and CLAIM button disabled (opacity 0.5, label 'OBJECTIVES INCOMPLETE') when incomplete. ME tab: holographic player card with rank stamp (FREAK/INTERMEDIATE), LV, class tier badge (S-CLASS / A-CLASS), class title (ALL-ROUNDER), rank frame label (CRIMSON PRIME for Freak, CYAN FRAME for Intermediate), COMBAT STATS radar (STR/PWR/SPD/END/GRT) all rendering with numeric percentile bars. change-avatar opens SELECT CLASS grid — 20 anime portraits present (avatar-avatar_shinobi, avatar-avatar_ronin, avatar-avatar_kaido, avatar-avatar_titan, avatar-avatar_saiyan, avatar-avatar_demon, avatar-avatar_wolf, avatar-avatar_ghost, avatar-avatar_dragon, avatar-avatar_coach, ...); ART tags visible; tapping updates portrait. SWIPE NAV: horizontal drag right-to-left in body area navigates from QUESTS -> SOCIAL (confirmed via SOCIAL HUB screenshot captured immediately after swipe); reverse swipe navigates back. Vertical taps and buttons remain functional (gesture uses horizontal activation threshold). Deprecated RN warnings still logging (not new): 'textShadow*' style props, 'shadow*' style props, and props.pointerEvents. No red-screen errors. No 500s. All 6 tabs render (HQ/TRAIN/RANK/QUESTS/SOCIAL/ME).

issues: 'OBJECTIVES INCOMPLETE' label on the disabled claim button is clear, but consider showing the missing amount inline (e.g. '1 more workout needed') under the GOAL row for better feedback.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still present in RankUpCelebration.tsx (and others). RN 0.76+: replace with 'textShadow' shorthand. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/RankUpCelebration.tsx

Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Player Card cardGlow uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx (styles.cardGlow)
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ScanlineOverlay.tsx

action_items: Optional polish: migrate remaining textShadow*/shadow*/pointerEvents deprecations (not blocking, cosmetic warnings only).
Optional UX: on the QUEST INFO modal, add a subtle 'X more to go' hint next to incomplete objectives so users know exactly how close they are to claim eligibility.
Optional: current 'OBJECTIVES INCOMPLETE' claim button label could be re-labeled based on the missing quantity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _build_quests: solid deterministic period keying (%Y-%m-%d / ISO week / %Y-%m) — no risk of drift between GET and CLAIM within the same period.
server.py claim_quest: enforces both 'objectives not met' and 'already claimed' correctly by re-running _build_quests inside the endpoint (single source of truth).
server.py profile_attributes: fetches ALL users' PRs on every call (async for loop over db.users.find({}) with {prs:1}); OK at seed scale but consider a Mongo aggregation ($sum) if user count grows.
quests.tsx: quest-claim button correctly gated by (!selected?.complete) with opacity fallback; global_percent is rendered from server so no client-side math drift.
SwipeTabs: horizontal threshold gesture doesn't block vertical scroll (confirmed via chat scroll + TRAIN protocol list scroll still working).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (quests tab render, scope chips, modal contents, claim gating, player card + class tier + rank frame, radar render, SELECT CLASS grid + avatar switch, swipe navigation)

seed_data_creation: test_quests.py registers throw-away quest_*/quest_a_*/quest_b_* users on each run. Also creates TEST_ prefixed workouts + chat messages. All isolated to test DB collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Seed accounts reset on backend startup (canonical XP/PRs). Fresh users needed for quest-claim mutation tests; register via /api/auth/register returns session_token. Daily 'Answer the Call' quest ID format: 'daily:d_train:YYYY-MM-DD' — parse period key from the id. Frontend testIDs: tab-{dashboard,workout,rank,quests,social,profile}, quest-scope-{daily,weekly,monthly,all}, quest-<full_id>, quest-claim, change-avatar, avatar-avatar_<name>. Swipe order: HQ→TRAIN→RANK→QUESTS→SOCIAL→ME (left swipe = next, right swipe = prev). Player-card class tier badge maps to overall from /api/profile/attributes (S=85+, A=70+, B=55+, C=40+, D=25+, E=<25).
